source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of electric potential energy (PDF 65-67).

blocks.text: Electric field mein rakha charge bijli ki potential energy rakhta hai. Agar charge qo ko charge q ke field mein rakh kar azad chhora jaye to q use dhakelta hai. Equation 16.17 dikhati hai ke potential faasle ke saath girta hai, is liye azad musbat charge hamesha zyada se kam potential ki taraf tez hota hai. Agar in nuqton ka potential difference dV ho to charge ki potential energy dU = qo dV kam hoti hai, aur yeh kami kinetic energy ban jati hai. Kamiyat m wale jism ke liye: (1/2) mv^2 = qo dV (16.18). Azad manfi charge kam se zyada potential ki taraf jata hai.

Equation 16.18 dikhati hai ke tawanai charge guna potential difference likhi ja sakti hai. Atomic physics mein electron volt (eV) use hota hai: woh tawanai jo electron 1 volt ke potential difference se tez hone par hasil karta hai. 1 eV = (electron ka charge) x 1 V = 1.6 x 10^-19 J.
Do point charges ki electric potential energy

Do nuqte A aur B lein jo r faasle par hon, aur shuru mein koi field na ho (Fig 16.4). Charge Q ko infinity se A tak layein: koi field mukhalfat nahi karta, is liye kaam WA = 0 (16.19). Ab Q, B par potential banata hai, V = (1/4 pi eo) Q / r (16.20). Doosre charge q ko infinity se B tak lane ka kaam WB = qV (16.21) = (1/4 pi eo) Qq / r (16.22). Kul kaam W = WA + WB = (1/4 pi eo) Qq / r (16.23). Ta'reef ke mutabiq yeh kaam jore ki electric potential energy ki shakal mein jama hota hai: Ep = (1/4 pi eo) Qq / r (16.24). Aik jaise charges ke liye Ep musbat aur mukhtalif charges ke liye manfi hai.

blocks.alt: Do dashed raste door (infinity) se neeche aate hain. Charge Q aik raste se nuqte A tak aata hai jahan VA = 0; charge q doosre raste se nuqte B tak jahan VB = V. Dashed teer A ko B se jorta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.4: Charges Q aur q infinity se nuqte A aur B tak laye gaye (kitab mein Fig. 16.5 chhapa; kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab is figure par 'Fig. 16.5' likhti hai, jabke matan isay Fig 16.4 kehta hai (Fig 16.5 agle topic ka gola hai). Pehle Q ko A par lane mein koi kaam nahi lagta kyunke wahan field nahi, is liye VA = 0. Phir Q ka potential B par V hai, is liye q ko B tak lane mein kaam qV lagta hai.

8 uC aur 5 uC ke do point charges 4.0 cm door hain. Un ki electric potential energy kya hai? Hal: Ep = (1/4 pi eo) Qq / r = (9 x 10^9 N m^2 C^-2)(8 x 10^-6 C)(5 x 10^-6 C) / (4 x 10^-2 m) = 9 N m = 9 J.

blocks.prompt: Electron 100 V se tez kiya jata hai. Woh kitni tawanai hasil karta hai, eV aur joules mein?

items: Azad musbat charge kam potential ki taraf: (1/2) mv^2 = qo dV.
Do charges: Ep = (1/4 pi eo) Qq / r.
